Subject: SableHealth — Hosted API pricing request (volume ramp)

Aisha / Karthik,

Quick summary from my call with Liam (SableHealth): they're planning a large ramp and want Host/API unit pricing rescaled. Highlights: 
- Expected ramp: ~500M tokens/mo in month 1 -> ~2B tokens/mo by month 6.
- Primary ask: 30% off our published hosted API per-token rate for 12 months.
- Procurement pushed back on committed spend requirements; they'd prefer consumption-based pricing with a simple discount.

Attachments: SableHealth_Month1_usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet) attached.

What I recommend as options to present (channeling deal desk feedback so we have a clear ask to execs):
1) 25% off hosted API for first 6 months in exchange for a $1.2M minimum billed commitment across months 1–6.
2) 22% off hosted API for 12 months with a 12-month auto-renew and a 12% overage protection threshold.
3) 20% standard volume discount (no commit) — negotiable by AM but doesn't need exec.

Liam wants a yes/no on whether we can go above 20% before they take this to procurement. This needs exec sign-off since it exceeds our standard discount band.

Requesting: can we escalate for exec approval for option 2 (22% for 12 months) or option 1 if leadership prefers a shorter-term concession?

Thanks,
Ben
---
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Ben—

Thanks for the write-up. I'm looping in Marissa and Karthik to get formal pricing guidance and to prepare the exec packet. Quick thoughts:
- Option 1 (25% for 6 months w/ $1.2M commit) reduces revenue risk and accelerates payback; strong option but requires finance + CRO approval.
- Option 2 (22% for 12 months with auto-renew) is cleaner for procurement and aligns with Sable's ask; still >20% so needs exec sign-off.

Marissa / Karthik — can you please draft a short one-page recommendation we can take to Rishi with: recommended concession level, projected net-new ARR (conservative & upside), and one-sentence risk/mitigation? I will prepare the HubSpot deal and attach the term-sheet draft.

Ben — please keep Sable on a soft timeline (we promised an answer by end of month). If procurement pushes for 30% we should present option 1 as our best commercial compromise.

Aisha

Subject: Exec packet: SableHealth concession recommendation

Aisha / Ben / Karthik —

Attached is the recommended packet for Rishi. TL;DR recommendation and analysis below.

Recommendation: Approve a 22% hosted API rate concession for 12 months (Option 2) with the following conditions:
- Legal to include a 12-month auto-renew clause and standard data protection addenda;
- Procurement to sign committed minimum of $1.0M billed in first 12 months OR tiered true-up to ensure minimum economics;
- Deal is contingent on inclusion of Redwood's usage monitoring hooks (cost/latency dashboards) in Sable's console access;
- Finance to flag this as a one-off commercial concession; no broader list price change.

Supporting numbers (conservative):
- Estimated billed revenue first 12 months: $2.8M (after concession).
- Gross margin impact: ~8 percentage points in months 1–3 while ramping capacity, recovers thereafter.
- Upside case with acceleration to 2B tokens/mo: incremental $4M+ ARR in year 2.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: free-riders / lower-than-expected commitment. Mitigation: $1.0M minimum or tiered clawback.
- Risk: operational load for burst capacity. Mitigation: reserved pool bump (temporary Dedicated credits) to avoid latency SLO breaches.

Attachments: Redwood_HostedAPI_term-sheet_v2.pdf, SableHealth_SOW_draft.docx

Ask: Rishi — please advise if you can approve 22% as a one-time executive concession under these terms. If you prefer a shorter concession window (6 months), we recommend approving Option 1 (25%).

Marissa
